sites.evidence_type: published tag insertion in the same loop or domain
sites.functional_impact_measured: FACS surface expression assay: HA-tagged GFP-hHCN4 detected on the cell surface under control conditions, confirming surface delivery; AICAR treatment reduced surface signal (interpreted as channel internalization, not tag-related misfolding).
sites.rationale: L1 explicitly names the S3–S4 extracellular loop as the HA-tag insertion site in a full-length, membrane-anchored HCN4 construct. The loop spans residues 360–375 (computed from landmarks), flanked by TM3 (341–359) and TM4 (376–386), giving 16 extracellular residues; the central portion (362–372) is ≥3 residues from either TM boundary and is sterically adequate for a ~15–23 aa insert. No specific residue is cited in the ledger, so insert_after_residue is left null and the site is reported at loop resolution. L2/L3 (PMC7691308) independently confirm extracellular HA tagging of full-length HCN4 but name no loop, providing corroboration without enabling a separate pinned site. Full-length GFP-hHCN4 construct with HA tag inserted into the S3–S4 extracellular loop (topology landmarks: TM3 341–359, loop 360–375, TM4 376–386), expressed in HEK293T cells; surface expression quantified by FACS under control and AICAR-treated conditions.

sources.claim: To confirm that the current reduction observed in the experiments shown above in HEK cells following AICAR treatment is due to a decreased expression of HCN4 channels on the cell membrane, we performed FACS analysis of HEK293T cells transfected with GFP-hHCN4-HA-tag inserted in the S3–S4 extracellular loop, under control conditions and after AICAR treatment.

sites.evidence_type: topology inference (C-terminal snorkel — no accessible terminus)
sites.rationale: C-terminus not extracellular (topology 'I' at residue L) and no accessible N-terminus — C-terminal snorkel presents the tag on the surface via a TM-snorkeling linker (fallback: no natively accessible terminus)
ordered surface loop (12 aa): pLDDT>=70, DSSP loop/turn, exposed junction residue (max RSA), indel-tolerant, 3D-clear of features

literature_notes: L2 and L3 (both PMC7691308) report an 'extracellular hemagglutinin (HA) tag' on full-length wild-type and V759I HCN4 used to measure surface trafficking in embryonic rat cardiomyocytes. However, neither clip names the loop or residue where the tag was inserted. Because HCN4 has three distinct extracellular loops (S1–S2: 288–295; S3–S4: 360–375; S5–S6: 429–491) and the N-terminus is intracellular (residues 1–262), no unique position can be topology-derived from these clips alone. They are therefore treated as corroborating evidence for the S3–S4 loop site established by L1, not as independent sites. V759I is a disease-associated missense mutation in the intracellular C-terminal domain (position 759 falls within the intracellular span 512–1203) and is not a tag-insertion site.
